goserelin is a safe and effective method to suppress the pituitary gland during controlled ovarian stimulation for in vitro fertilization (IVF).

the use of a GnRH antagonist in an IVF cycle is associated with a significantly higher incidence of ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) and that GnRH antagonist protocols are associated with a higher rate of multiple pregnancies than long protocols using GnRH agonists.
